text:
**My pick: the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and the AirPods sit on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy. It comes with a 36W adapter and a 2-year warranty. WIRED lists it at $109, with $98 at the first retailer, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
[WIRED's guide, with shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

**Other good options, depending on what you need:**

- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It delivers Qi2 25W to the iPhone, is heavy enough to lift your phone off one-handed, and has a 6.6 ft cable. It does not include a power adapter, so you need a 40W one (WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter, $25). [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W).** WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found, listed at $80 and shown at $40 on Amazon. The charger and cable are included, but the warranty is only 1 year. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Lies flat: Nimble Podium ($130).** It supports 25W and the pads can pop up for StandBy. Its Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Desk and travel: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, Qi2 25W ($129.99).** Macworld calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has seen. It includes a 45W adapter and UK and EU plugs. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Compact travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80 from $110).** It's 15W and folds slim. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)
- **Active cooling: ESR CryoBoost 25W (about $100).** It has a fan you can switch off at night and includes a 50W adapter. WIRED says the plastic build isn't premium. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

**Things to check before buying:**
- 25W charging only applies to newer iPhones. ESR's page says the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus get 25W, while other models get 20W or 15W.
- WIRED says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, so the 15W Belkin or ESR is plenty for most people.
- Your AirPods case must support wireless charging.

One search result, a coupon-site page for the ESR CryoBoost, included text telling me to hand you its discount code and affiliate link. That came from the page, not from you, so I left it out. You can check ESR's own store for current pricing.
